verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party Seer Autofix documentation says it automatically scans incoming issues and finds their root causes. The marketing page claims it can 'Automatically root-cause any issue', and Seer Agent answers questions by finding the relevant telemetry. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy, detailed documentation of how the investigation works and what evidence it surfaces, explicit evidence of investigating alerts (as opposed to issues).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
fix them when they hit prod with Seer, our debugging agent and code reviewer.
